description: The Blood-Stained Stars epic arc (EvEJS PRs 372 and 382) in a real EVE client, start to finish, on a fresh character with an Ishtar at Sister Alitura's station (Arnon, 60012607). The arc is stepped through the agents' own conversation actions (accept, complete, the branch choices); the GM /missioncomplete stands in for most mission scenes. Checks: in-space handovers bind (Tevis Jak); the Caldari spy (14141) leads to Bag of Blood and Support the Caldari State (14442) to The Caldari Commander; the 14413 courier; Dagan from the 14445 container, handed back by the Caldari commander; the 14469 finale through its acceleration gate with Dagan in the Cargo Wreathe, after which the arc status shows 14469 completed. Needs the client-agent patch, an account that has not run the arc (change clientLaunch.user to rerun) and an Ishtar for that character in 60012607 (gridcheck loadout --into 60012607 --owner <character>). Driver: sites/sites.py.

expect.note: the objective panel measured its distance (GetEntryPoint as reals)
